text:
eli-platform: Quick sync — we need to decide on the client-visible taxonomy for routing vs quota vs capacity signals. I'll float a small header-first proposal below.

anna-ux: +1 to making the client copy short. Clients want clear retry guidance and a machine-readable field.

sam-sre: Problem: 429 subcodes are easy to ignore. Does anyone actually want a new numeric status? proxies and CDNs sometimes treat unknown codes oddly.

lina-pm: Product ask: customers need deterministic action. Quota = don't retry until reset. Routing degrade = may retry with backoff or fallback model. Capacity shortage = try another region/tier.

mike-eng: Implementation note: we can either reuse 429/503 combos or add a stable header like `X-Redwood-Error-Type`. Header avoids unknown status code issues and is SDK-friendly.

rosie-docs: Docs + console impact: if we add a header we must update console badges and the example payloads. Also examples for `retry_after` vs `retryable` flags.

eli-platform: Proposal (minimal, header-first):
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-Redwood-Error-Type: quota_exceeded
Retry-After: 3600
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "retry_after": 3600,
  "actionable_hint": "reduce-batch-size or request dedicated capacity",
  "error_class": "quota",
  "error_reason": "monthly_token_limit"
}
```
Header values: quota_exceeded | route_degraded | capacity_shortage | transient_failure
Body fields: error (string), retry_after (seconds|null), retryable ("yes"|"no"), actionable_hint (short string), error_class (partition for telemetry)

anna-ux: For console UX: map to three badges: quota -> red with "quota exhausted" text, route_degraded -> yellow "degraded, fallback served" with link to routing docs, capacity_shortage -> orange "regional capacity low" with recommended action. Keep messages < 80 chars.

sam-sre: Telemetry needs strict enum tags. Suggested tags: `redwood.error.class`, `redwood.error.type`, `redwood.route.bucket`, `redwood.retryable`. Avoid free-text `actionable_hint` for metrics.

mike-eng: Rollout plan: (1) implement header in runtime and proxies, surface in SDKs as enum; (2) canary in 10% of traffic for 2 weeks; (3) enable console badging for canary orgs only; (4) flip globally.

lina-pm: We need billing + legal signoff before exposing named quota buckets in `error_reason`. Might switch to opaque codes like `quota_01` and map in console.

rosie-docs: Docs TODOs: examples for REST and curl, SDK sample handling, migration note for clients that parse only status code. I'll draft a short guide.

eli-platform: Edge cases: proxies that strip custom headers — we should also include fields in JSON body as fallback. Also consider internationalization of `actionable_hint` (keep it English-only but link to localized playbooks).

sam-sre: One more: rate-limiter vs quota - they look similar but different semantics. `error_class` should be `quota` vs `rate_limit` vs `routing`. Keep telemetry separate.

mike-eng: SDK behavior: expose a typed Error object with fields: type(enum), class(enum), retryAfter(int|null), retryable(bool), reason(string, opaque). Provide convenience .shouldRetry() logic.

lina-pm: Can we add a small human-friendly `client_message` for apps to show to end-users? Eg: "Service temporarily limited — try again later" vs raw quota text. Must be short and non-sensitive.

anna-ux: yes — `client_message` (<= 120 chars) and `console_link` (optional) to send user to status/help.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: runtime/error-header-proto -> canary next_wed 02:00 UTC. CI pipeline will notify.

eli-platform: Action items: sam - define telemetry enums + event schema; mike - SDK error shape + shouldRetry; rosie - docs + examples; anna - console badge designs; lina - confirm billing/legal for `error_reason` exposure. I'll write RFC with header-first rollout and PR template.

rosie-docs: I'll add a short migration note for clients that only check status code.

sam-sre: Agree. Also instrument a new alert for spike in `redwood.error.type=route_degraded` so we catch rollout regressions.

eli-platform: Thanks all — I'll seed the RFC by EOD.
